content_descriptors.notes:
This game depicts the complexities of life in the ancient world. It does not shy away from the realities of Roman society and includes some brutality, decadence, and moral contradictions. Players will encounter mature themes such as violence, exploitation, substance use as well as moments of psychological tension and horror.

While dramatised, these elements reflect the world as it was, different but deeply human. Player discretion is advised if sensitive to any of these themes.

legal_notice: True Roman is a work of fiction all characters and events depicted in this game and associated materials have no relation to real life persons nor specific events. Any exceptions are long dead historical figures and are named as such.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any modern Linux distribution (e.g., Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch)
  • Processor: 2 GHz dual-core processor or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics should be fine (Intel HD Graphics, AMD, etc.)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer (other distros should work)
  • Processor: 2 GHz quad-core processor or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics (NVIDIA or AMD, any recent model)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: An interactive story-driven adventure set in ancient Rome, where your choices shape the fates themselves. Navigate moral dilemmas, uncover mythic secrets, and experience a deeply immersive narrative influenced by philosophical ideals and consequence-driven gameplay.
